## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] The problem and requirements match the milestone.
- [ ] The design change is described, including what was left out.
- [ ] Testing commands and actual output are in the PR.
- [ ] At least one failure scenario is demonstrated, or its absence is explicit.
- [ ] Security and operational notes match the code that shipped.
- [ ] Docs updated in this PR match the behavior a reviewer can run.
